security.title: Account security
security.intro: Manage your backup email without changing your primary address.
security.passwordHint: Required to add, resend or remove. Never saved on this device.
security.wait: You can request another code in {{seconds}} s.
security.removeWarning: Your backup email and any pending verification will be removed. You will lose this alternative method. Your primary email stays the same.
security.confirmRemove: I confirm I want to remove my backup email and cancel pending verification.
security.previousActive: Your previous verified address stays active until you confirm the new one.
security.futureRecovery: Password recovery through backup email is not available in this version.
security.noticeFailed: Your change was saved, but the notice to your primary address could not be sent.

success.request: We sent a code to your proposed address. Check your spam folder too.
success.resend: We sent a new code. The previous code is no longer valid.
success.remove: Backup email and pending codes removed.

errors.connection: A connection problem prevented us from confirming the result. Check the status before repeating the operation.
errors.generic: We could not complete the operation. Refresh the status and try again.
errors.backup_address_unavailable: This address cannot be used. It must differ from your primary email and not already be in use.
errors.backup_no_challenge: No pending verification. Refresh the status or request a code.
errors.backup_cooldown: Please wait before requesting another code.
errors.backup_rate_limited: Operation limit reached. Wait up to an hour before trying again.
errors.backup_mail_unavailable: We could not send the email. Your previous state is unchanged. Try again later.
errors.backup_code_expired: This code has expired. Request a new one.
errors.backup_attempts_exhausted: No attempts remaining. Request a new code when available.
errors.backup_invalid_input: Check your email, password and code format.
